d: Company Description TEBABAH HOME HEALTH CARE (THHC) is a home health care provider dedicated to delivering high-standard medical services in the comfort of patients’ homes. The organization focuses on improving quality of life, reducing hospitalizations, and maintaining a supportive, healthy environment for patients and their families. Care is provided by a multidisciplinary team that includes experienced doctors, registered nurses, physiotherapists, and other allied health professionals. THHC follows international standards for home health care and is proud to be accredited by Jawda & Tasneef, reflecting its commitment to quality and patient safety.

Role Description The Home Health Care Nurse with DOH/DHA license will provide comprehensive nursing care to patients in their homes in Al Ain. This full-time, on-site role includes assessing patient conditions, administering medications and treatments, performing wound care, and monitoring vital signs. The nurse will collaborate with physicians and the multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized care plans, educate patients and families on disease management and prevention, and promote safe, evidence-based practices. Daily responsibilities also include accurate documentation, reporting changes in patient status, supporting discharge and follow-up plans, and contributing to quality improvement initiatives within the home health care setting.
q: Strong clinical competencies in Nursing and Medicine, with the ability to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care.
Demonstrated experience in Home Care and Patient Care, including managing patients with chronic conditions in a home setting.
Proficiency in Wound Care, including dressing changes, infection prevention, and monitoring healing progress.
Valid DOH or DHA nursing license and eligibility to practice in the UAE.
Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or equivalent from an accredited institution.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.
Ability to travel to patient homes within Al Ain and adapt to varied home environments.
Commitment to patient safety, confidentiality, and adherence to international and facility-specific quality standards.
Previous home health care experience and proficiency in electronic medical records are considered an advantage.

d: As a Service Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in executing retrofit upgrades, system extensions, and modifications for Substation Automation systems and delivering Service Level Agreement (SLA) programs. You will lead assignments of low to high complexity, ensuring all site activities are completed efficiently, cost-effectively, and fully aligned with contractual obligations, quality standards, and safety requirements.
Represent the Service Engineering function in project and customer meetings, contributing to the development of project execution philosophies and plans, and ensuring their effective implementation.
Serve as a key technical interface with customers, ensuring Hitachi Energy is consistently presented as a professional and trusted partner.
Coordinate with customers and external entities to prepare project documents, execution schedules, acceptance criteria, resolve open items, and complete acceptance testing activities.
Execute service engineering activities such as system integrations, factory testing and site implementations in accordance with approved processes to ensure on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery.
Perform system modifications, extensions, and upgrades, including -Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), energization checks, and final system acceptance as required.
Develop HMI configurations, and system databases according to project specifications.

Prepare project documentation such as System Architecture, Signal Lists, Component Configuration Documents, Project schedules, FAT & SAT procedures, Method of Statement (MoS), Risk Assessments (RA), Site Visit Reports, Incident Reports, and Root Cause Analyses (RCA), in coordination with team leads and project managers.
Ensure strict compliance with internal processes, external regulations, cybersecurity requirements, and safety protocols.
Support continuous improvement by providing structured lessons learned, supporting claims (scope, cost, and time impacts), and enabling product and process enhancements.
Contribute to the development of service activity estimates during tendering, helping define work scopes and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges.
Manage external partners providing equipment or services, ensuring compliance with health, safety, and quality requirements.
Take initiative to drive innovation, improve engineering solutions, and enhance customer value.

Demonstrate Hitachi Energy’s core values of Safety and Integrity, taking personal responsibility for safe behavior and ethical decision-making while promoting a strong safety culture within the team and at customer sites.
Perform real-time risk and opportunity assessments throughout project execution, identifying potential variations and supporting contract claim preparation.
Provide timely reporting of contract issues, quality concerns, scheduling risks, and cost deviations, along with actionable recommendations.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related field.
6–10 years of experience as an SCMS engineer with proven design, testing, and commissioning expertise.
Strong command of Substation Automation Systems, including communication protocols such as IEC 101, IEC 104, IEC 61850, LON, SPA, Modbus, and others.
Advanced proficiency with Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA and RTU systems, as well as IEDs from various manufacturers.
Hands-on experience with engineering tools like MS Office, Visio, IET, ITT, PCM, MiCOM, DIGSI, and related applications.
Solid understanding of substation control logic, interlocking schemes, and power system operational principles.
Intermediate knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards, practices, solutions (Firewall, NIDS, WSUS, RADIUS Configuration) and testing methodologies.
Excellent communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English.
Willingness to travel 100% to customer sites.
